images.alt: Thursday Minimum observed temperature. A map of the country with a number of locations and their lowest observed temperature overnight. Auckland airport 2, Hamilton -4, Taumarunui -6, Palmerston north 0, Wellington 4, Christchurch -4, Queenstown -5, Dunedin city 1, Invercargill -5

post.text:
🥶 I hope you're keeping warm on the coldest morning of the year

📉 The mercury has plummeted across the country with many places recording their coldest temperature this year. Auckland's the coldest it's been since 2021 and Taumarunui has recorded its 3rd coldest temperature ever (records from 2007)

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
